capabilities: : Control playback with a custom player
: Pin media to the top of the pane

intentEvidence: Click timestamps in transcription documents to seek and play the embedded audio/video
problem: Users often struggle to quickly navigate and control embedded audio or video within long transcription documents.
summary: A plugin that allows users to click timestamps in transcription documents to seek and play embedded audio or video using a custom player.
